 Taurus Shani Horoscope Today, 11 November 2026: Moon Moves Into Jyeshtha by Late Morning, Shani Retrograde Asks for Rest

 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 11, 2026, 01:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print By late morning on Wednesday, the Moon slips into Jyeshtha, the last nakshatra of Scorpio, which sits in your seventh house of partners and public dealings. Jyeshtha is the star of the eldest, the one who carries responsibility for everyone else. For Taurus, that can mean a spouse, client or business associate leaning on you more than usual. Shani, retrograde in Pisces and casting its third aspect onto your own sign, sends a clear counter-message. You cannot pour from an empty cup, and today your body may insist on a pause. Carrying Other People’s Load 
 Jyeshtha has a protective nature. Under it, you may feel duty-bound to solve a partner’s problem, cover for a colleague or step in during a family tangle. Helping is admirable. Taking on every burden is not. By evening, tiredness can turn into irritation if you agree to too much. Say yes to what truly needs you. Let the rest wait until the weekend. Shani’s Reminder About Your Energy 
 Shani is your yogakaraka, ruling your ninth and tenth houses, and it sits in your eleventh. Its glance on Taurus slows physical energy during this retrograde phase. Heavy eyes in the afternoon, a stiff back, or a dull headache may signal you haven't slept enough. Shani rewards those who rest properly before pushing forward again. Venus and Mercury Near Their Turning Points 
 Venus, your ruling planet, is still retrograde in Virgo, your fifth house, and turns direct on Saturday. Mercury, lord of your second house of savings, slows almost to a stop in Libra before going direct on Friday. These two days before the stations often feel foggy. Choices about money, leisure plans or creative work are better left until the weekend, when both planets move forward. Bhai Dooj and a Gentle Evening 
 Today is also Bhai Dooj. A warm visit with a sibling suits the mood, as long as it stays relaxed. Mars, lord of your twelfth house of rest, spends its last day in Cancer before moving into Leo on Thursday evening. Ending the day early will help you meet that shift with fresh energy. What to Do Today 
 Finish essential tasks in the first half of the day, before the Moon fully settles into Jyeshtha. When a partner or colleague asks for help, offer what you can manage without stretching yourself thin. Take a short break after lunch, even if it is only fifteen minutes with your eyes closed. Postpone money decisions and creative commitments until Saturday. Enjoy Bhai Dooj quietly, eat a light dinner, and go to bed earlier than usual. Shani Remedy for Today 
 Offer a few drops of sesame oil to an image or idol of Lord Shani in the evening and pray for steady health. Gift a small folding stool to a street vendor or security guard who stands on their feet all day.
